card.name: Compatibility and applicability restrictions
card.fires_on: Words that start a statement about what something works with, applies to, or where an offer is valid, such as 'not' in 'not applicable', 'works', 'Applies', and 'only'. Seen in product, software and offer fine print.

modes.label: Offer limits
modes.description: Terms of a promotion saying where or to whom it applies.
modes.example: Offer expires June 30. *Discount<< not>> applicable on SES Online products.

modes.label: Works with / system requirements
modes.description: Words stating which software, versions or devices a product supports.
modes.example: RepliStor<< works>> with any version of Win2K or

modes.label: Applies to
modes.description: Heading or phrase introducing the range of models or items covered.
modes.example: |ARM Technical Support Knowledge Articles| Ap<<plies>> to: ARM7TDMI MAS

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like 'available' and 'all/most', which suggests a scope or availability statement comes next.
card.plain: It fires on fine-print words that say what something works with or where an offer applies.
